events.text: The GM posted an empty message.
The group crossed the stone bridge and arrived at the large round stone corridor.
Anaiel stepped forward and looked up at the runes on the rope.
The runes were identified as a primal alarm spell drawing power from the trees.
Antoine said the alarm might have a password or could be disabled.
Rubel tried to contact Finara through the seashell ring about the alarm password.
The GM asked what happens next.
GM asked what happened next.
Anaiel looked around the area for something to disable the rope.
GM asked what happened next.
GM asked what happens next.
GM asked what next.
Rubel planned to spend 20 minutes disarming the rope trap.
The tree guardians lay down and fell asleep.
Rubel earned a hero point.
Rubel continued toward the arches watching for alarms.
Anaiel followed behind carefully.
The party stood in the centre of the room and felt faint magic from the arches.
The tips glowed with colours and pointed toward the closest arch.
Rubel rolled a natural 20 Arcana check to learn how the device worked.
Rubel approached the arches with the device to record them.
Rubel prepared to leave with the party and asked about rearming the rope trap.
Anaiel asked Fianara what it was.
The party heard the theory about the real Seven Arches hidden in the Wilewood.
Fianara pulled out a large locked bound book.
Fianara asked Rubel to fill the book with findings and return it.
Anaiel promised to fill the book and took it from Fianara.
Anaiel asked if they should travel to the Vine Hall.
Rubel agreed to go.
GM posted an image.
GM posted an image.
An angel-blooded dwarf druid approached the group in the courtyard and asked their business.
GM asked what happens next.
Anaiel said Fianara had recommended they come.
The dwarf led the group to the large hall covered in vines.
The dwarf left and a vine-covered horse approached.
A halfling druid in ceremonial robes dismounted from the horse.
Lemma Feldthorn introduced herself and asked what the group knew about the arches.
Eimer said they were there to find the seven arches.
Anaiel gripped her wrist and asked what had changed and how.
Lemma Feldthorn explained the Bolan threat and the shadow-wither key.
Lemma Feldthorn handed Rubel 15 gold pieces.
Lemma Feldthorn promised horses, a cart, dorms and armoury access.
Illiani introduced herself to the party.
Cyrus greeted the party and set Illiani down.
Lemma Feldthorn told the party to follow the squirrel.
Cyrus started to follow the squirrel.
Illiani followed Cyrus and Rubel.
The squirrel led the group through winding corridors.
The group crossed bridges woven from living roots.
The squirrel stopped before double doors revealing the druidic armory.
The undead druid greeted the visitors.
Cyrus requested warmer garments, a blanket and hoof tools.
Rubel sold goggles, tools, armor and kukris.
Rubel sold the mosquito animal staff.
The blight druid asked if there was anything else.
Tallied cold iron weapon costs.
Totaled adventuring equipment costs.
Bought a composite shortbow.
Said the party should go to the dorms and rest.

scenes.location: long room filled with bunk beds

events.text: Went to a long room filled with bunk beds.
Said Illiani would sleep in the baths.
Had breakfast and set off the next day.
Set off across the River kingdoms.
Said he was trained in survival.
Offered a compass for navigation.
Suggested taking the horses in and leaving the cart.
Offered to cast light cantrips in the woods.
Loaded supplies into bags and pouches.
Reached a massive circular clearing.
Saw seven arches along the clearing.
Investigated the arches and their history.
Were ambushed by two shadowy wolf-like creatures.
Entered combat.
Started setting up combat on Foundry.
Shadow dogs mauled Illiani and left her dying, then the party killed both dogs.
The party advanced toward the arches and shifted into a monochrome illusion.
Everyone was ordered to roll Fortitude saves against planar warping damage.
The party found masked oak stewards sacrificing a sedated unicorn.
Rubel killed one steward, another was knocked out, and Korimona surrendered.
Illiani freed and treated the unicorn and Korimona agreed to lead the party to Bolan.
Korimona led the group through the woods for an hour to a larger clearing.
The party saw painted wooden houses in trees linked by rope bridges.
The GM warned sentries at the gate house would spot and shoot intruders.
Korimona said rebels numbered almost twenty and opposed civilisation.
Anaiel stepped forward and suggested fighting together.
GM asked if the party would go up the stairs into the fortress.
Anaiel questioned leading the way as prisoners.
Ryo said the party needed a loud or bright signal.
GM asked for two stealth rolls for the fortress approach and staircase.
GM said the party was in area 1 the gatehouse.
There was a sleeping pangolin in a cage next to the party.
Rubel hit a druid in the throat for 13 damage.
Rifon turned and yelled intruder.
Two leshys appeared.
Cyrus cast Warp Step and advanced to the first guard with shield raised.
The party ran up the spiral staircase.
The druids were shocked.
The massive minotaur rounded the corner.
The leshies found this amusing.
Anaiel sprinted up the stairs and attacked with rifle and thunderstrike.
Rubel planned to break the cage, grab the animal, and move behind the staircase pillar.
Scrit remained restrained and skipped his turn.
Scrit attempted to tear apart the restraints.
Scrit cast Scatter Scree at two enemies on the bridge, creating difficult terrain.
Menelimus died.
Rifon was badly wounded.
Allisee moved up behind Scrit and hunted prey on the druid summoner.
Anaiel dealt 17 damage and exploded Rifon's head.
Wisteria's punch covered Anaiel in thick slowing vines.
Anaiel shot the viper's head off.
Scrit strode forward and grappled the leshy on the other side of the bridge.
Illiani moved up and shot arrows towards the enemy on the bridge.
Aekold hunted his prey and tried to recall weaknesses.
Cyrus cast Soothe on Rubel and raised his shield.
Anaiel shot the closest terrorists and cast thunderstrike.
The leshy died.
Combat ended.
The GM offered a choice of NORTH or WEST.
Scrit walked across the bridge and saw a man.
Illiani stepped across the bridge and greeted the others.
Illiani called for help and asked for a spare waterskin.
Rubel brought a waterskin and rations and introduced himself.
Scrit administered healing elixirs to the hurt people.
Verge reported that both of the doors were locked.
The party entered the fabric production room.
The party found looms and textiles.
The party found a door to the north.
The party found a ladder leading up the treehouse.
Anaiel suggested going up the ladder.
Verge examined the loom and compared the north exit to the ladder.
The party found a library and a laboratory.
The party met a dwarven Oak steward.
The dwarf asked about the noise from downstairs.
The party saw a purple and golden spider biting a web-wrapped leshy.
Delphon introduced himself.
Delphon praised the party for stopping the attackers.
Rubel tricked Delphon and climbed down to signal an ambush.
Scrit hid against the wall using leaf weave.
Delphon arrived at the bottom of the ladder.
Combat started when Delphon saw the group.
Delphon died.
Scrit named the spider Octo.
Scrit climbed up the ladder.
Verge followed up the ladder.
Rode the spider up the ladder.
Found the poison lab.
Found books, glass vessels, burners and distilling equipment.
Raided the shelves.
Sent loot to the party stash.
Went back down the ladder.
Opened the door and found a dining hall.
Saw a grig and a sprite jump out.
Scrit entered a rage and threw a Blasting Stone that missed.
Cyrus hit the sprite with his sword and raised his shield.
Anaiel killed both fey.
Heard struggling sounds from the poison lab.
Scrit followed the spider to a cocoon and began freeing Twilight.
Twilight stood up and checked for injuries.
Noticed Laetheron had a whale tattoo.
Twilight wandered out of the lab.
Scrit followed on his spider.
Cyrus followed behind.
Were asked to cross the rope bridge to the North.
Scrit crossed the bridge checking stability.
Scrit checked the door for creatures.
Found a storage room.
Explored the storage room.
Added loot to the party stash.
Found a door to the North-East.
Learned two pixies were having a party on cake.
Saw something move in a large jar.
Axtra asked the faeries to let her out of the jar.
Twilight asked the faeries to release the person in the jar.
Combat began against the fey.
Scrit threw a bomb that splashed both pixies.
Cyrus swung his sword at the remaining pixie.
Anaiel shot and killed the last pixie, ending combat.
Axtra climbed out of the jar after Anaiel opened it.
The party exchanged introductions with Axtra.
Twilight said they were seeking the conclave leader.
Twilight found Axtra's belongings in the small room.
Twilight remarked the place was bigger than expected.
The GM explained the treehouse was well defended by guards and traps.
Rubel noted a path on the right.
Rubel and Illiani deactivated the explosive trap on the door.
The party backed into the room and peeked into the next room.
Arctus poked.
The party crossed the rope bridge.
The party opened the door.
The party found themselves in a workshop.
The workshop was described as a mess with a makeshift nest and doors onto rope bridges.
Cyrus said the party meant no harm and wished to speak with Bolan.
Glit offered the chest contents to stay and finish his building.
Cyrus packed his tools and joined the party to move forward.
The party agreed to proceed up the stairs.
Arctus poked.
The party proceeded up the stairs.
Loot was sent to stash.
The party went up the wooden stairs.
The treehouse appeared more primally magical as they climbed.
The party encountered an old woman along the walkway.
Jeraya introduced herself and said they set off the alarms.
Jeraya introduced Moss as her spirit fox.
Jeraya stabbed Axtra in the face.
Axtra struck Jeraya with flames.
Illiani cast Forbidden Thought naming strike on the old woman stabbing friendlies.
Jeraya fell back spluttering blood.
Axtra appealed to Jeraya to give up.
Jeraya fell to one knee and threatened to call upon the power of the trees.
The fox spirit readied to attack and defend his master.
A new player asked to join as Gregory Herb, a Universal school wizard.
The shot hit her shoulder and killed her immediately.
The fox spirit came to rest on her corpse.
Axtra knelt next to the fox-like creature and mourned Moss.
Axtra picked up the fox and asked where to go next.
The central building had locked reinforced wooden doors with pipes.
The single door to the water management room looked unlocked.
Axtra approached the northern doors of the water management room to open them carefully.
Axtra pushed the door open into the water management room.
The party deciphered the Gnomish labels and noticed the main tank was bulging.
Axtra began turning the emergency vent valves to release pressure.
Axtra turned the main wheel and dropped the first gauge out of the red.
Axtra released the remaining pressure, disengaging the reinforced doors and unlocking the broom closet.
Rubel opened the broom closet door and saw King.
The group found big pods with liquid drained onto the floor in the room.
Caspian drew his warhammer and asked who put them in the pods and where they were.
Glowing whale tattoos with mythical beings were noticed on everyone.
Axtra recognized Iris by the boiler and embraced her sister.
Caspian introduced himself as a former dignitary turned adventurer.
Axtra led the group to the large door and pushed it open.
Companions stood by side ready for what came next.
The door opened.
Party entered the room.
Party found themselves in the alchemy lab.
Northern door was unlocked by the water mechanism.
Party opened this door.
Party found themselves in a lodging room.
Found dozens of bunk beds.
Found a big cage with about 20 gnomes in the corner.
Heard a prayer-like voice and leaf-like speech beyond the reinforced door.
Broke down the northern door.
Saw Bolan standing behind the desk.
Axtrakeela entered the room and asked for Bolan.
Bolan said he was the Plant-Necromancer.
Bolan lunged to attack.
Cyrus found a diary detailing plans in the desk.
The party leveled up to level 2.
Doctor Edward Ritalson said Bolan was only a pawn and his master was a fey.
The party freed the gnomes and left the treehouse.
Doctor Edward Ritalson put the unicorn to sleep with purple magic.
Doctor Edward Ritalson said the unicorn's voice would return when it awakened.
Korimona asked if the party killed Bolan.
Korimona said the party were chosen and asked to join their adventures.
Illiani said Korimona deserved an opportunity to make up for her mistakes.
Korimona thanked the party at their feet.
Korimona said Bolan seemed special because of the mark's aura.
Illiani suggested the mark might magically influence people.
Ritalson explained the mark made simpler minds see bearers as leaders.
Illiani condemned the mark's magic and urged never to use it.
Ritalson said he would teleport the party to Seven Arches.
Ritalson teleported the group back to the vinehall of the Oak Stewards.
Lemma thanked the party for killing Bolan and freeing the gnomes.
Lemma gave the party 25 gold pieces.
Lemma expressed disappointment that the Shadow-Wither key was not recovered.
Lemma fed the party and provided washing and beds to rest.
The next day arrived.
The party was sent to the grand library to do research.
The party gained full access to the grand library through Oak Steward access.
The party spent the day researching and gained 1 investigation point.
Cyrus's diary revealed Bolan's master was called The Slim.
The party reached 4 investigation points and completed the research.
The stewards asked the party to visit attacked merchant Pablo Moss.
Pablo Moss lay in a hospital bed murmuring random words.
Illiani tried speaking directly into Pablo's mind with mentalism.
Rubel tried first-aid methods to assess Pablo's cognition.
Twilight examined Pablo and asked what was wrong with him.
Cyrus shouted at Pablo in a drill instructor impression to make him talk.
Pablo snapped out of his confusion after intimidation.
Pablo told the party about the shadow man attack.
Pablo said the being killed Hatria Pebblesworth.
Pablo thanked the party and needed more rest.
Oak stewards took the party to the morgue.
Party saw Pebblesworth's body and her torn donkey.
Twilight examined the body and guessed at the cause.
Illiani recited mantras to read psychic impressions.
Anna found soot indicating planar travel.
Alitheia found herself floating in a dark void.
Alitheia raised her shield and looked for reference.
Alitheia tried to walk forward through the void.
A voice echoed about delivery to SCREECH.
Perception check passed with a value of 19.
Nature check passed with a value of 17.
Survival check critically passed with a value of 30.
Anthony noted every roll was passed.
Cannon claimed an earlier arcana pass.
Alitheia called out to the unseen voices.
Voices discussed her naming by SCREECH.
Thirteen immense chained mythical beings appeared.
Alitheia lowered her shield and questioned the prison.
Alitheia paused at the phoenix feeling warmth.
Nature showed two killers and shadow fey fed on the donkey.
Twilight found large barefoot tracks that only watched.
Rubel discovered Pebblesworth cast no shadow.
Party learned the morgue gave all it could.
Party learned they must go to The Thin Lands.
Alitheia brought her blade down on the phoenix restraints.
An explosion of light enveloped Alitheia.
Something left the phoenix and entered Alitheia.
A mark with a phoenix appeared on her flesh.
Alitheia woke up after two years passed.
Alitheia suited up and followed warmth to strangers.
Twilight greeted Alitheia and mentioned the Thin Lands murder.
Alitheia introduced herself as an acolyte of Sarenrae.
Party recognized Alitheia as marked.
Party learned they woke up in a fluid pod.
Alitheia showed her phoenix tattoo and asked about the dream.
Alitheia offered to join with fighting and basic medical training.
Anna asked if the group should leave the morgue.
Doctor Edward Ritalson walked into the room.
Doctor Ritalson offered to teleport the group nearby.
Doctor Ritalson built a portal from purple lightning.
A vortex pulled the group across reality to the farm lands.
The party arrived on a stony road in the farmlands.
The party saw farm houses spread across rolling hills.
The party searched the misty hills and low valleys for fey magic.
Farmers told Cyrus about fey blights.
Alitheia helped the group navigate the hills.
Twilight failed to provide the needed nature knowledge.
The party went through a thicket to a clearing.
The party found a bird with broken wings in a stick symbol.
Twilight held a short rite over the bird corpse.
Twilight followed the primal magic trail toward its source.
Three large shadow creatures ambushed the party.
Rubel killed a Shadow of Hunger.
Twilight Garden killed Shadow of Hunger #01.
Illiani killed the last Shadow of Hunger.
The party gathered 3 sets of Dark Fey Blood worth 39 GP.

time_cues: As the day is coming to an end
as the light of the sun dips down

events.text: Continued onwards and broke through the treeline to a clearing with a portal.
Identified the view through the portal as the Shadow Lands of the First World.
Noticed a whale etching on the portal stone.
Sensed the source of the dead bird ritual lay beyond the portal.
Anna objected to going through the shadow portal.
Watched the portal swirl and glimpsed movement beyond the veil.
Agreed to head through the portal.
